for s in A['full_tree_inventory']:
 p=R/s['relative_path']

n=0
with (D/'occurrences.jsonl').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
 for s in A['sources']:
  doc=s['document_id']
  if s.get('extracted_records'):
   q=R/s['extraction_artifact'];field='location'
  elif doc in ('1-10','11-20','21-30'):
   q=R/'evidence/math/pages'/doc/'body-records.jsonl';field='paragraph'
  else:continue
  raw=q.read_bytes()
  expected=next(x['sha256'] for x in A['artifact_bindings'] if x['path']==q.relative_to(R).as_posix()) if field=='paragraph' else s['actual_extraction_sha256']
  if sha(raw)!=expected:raise ValueError('Extraction changed: '+str(q))
  for line in raw.decode('utf-8-sig').split('\n'):
   if not line.strip():continue
   rec=json.loads(line);i=rec[field]
   loc=rec.get('locator',f'IWA::body-paragraph[{i}]::UTF16[{rec.get("utf16_range",[])}]')
   oid=sha((s['sha256']+'\0'+s['source_path']+'\0'+loc).encode('utf-8'))

   f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');n+=1
if n!=A['counts']['primary_extracted_locations']:raise ValueError('Occurrence census differs: '+str(n))
